latin: Quod dicit Abucaten, intelligentiam esse substantiam quae non diuiditur, maxime est uerum per indiscretam in ea intelligibilium ad inuicem penetrationem.
translation: Abucaten's claim that intelligence is an undivided substance holds true above all because the intelligibles within it interpenetrate one another without any separation.
